hero.titleLine2: A cross-platform native runtime for web apps, built on .NET MAUI.
hero.description: Use modern web tooling to build high-performance native apps for Android, iOS, Windows and macOS — all powered by a single C# runtime.
hero.platformsLabel: Supports Android, iOS, macOS and Windows
hero.productAlt: Napacitor layered product concept: web app, .NET MAUI runtime and multi-platform support

01.title: Drop Napacitor into any existing web app.

02.title: Init, sync, and scaffold the native runtime
02.description: Specify the app ID, name, and web asset directory. Napacitor generates a MAUI project and bundles plugins automatically.

03.title: Run on any platform
03.description: Pick a target platform: android / ios / maccatalyst / windows.

capabilities.title: Core Capabilities
capabilities.description: Build apps with the web technologies you already know — running equally on iOS, Android and the Web, accessing each platform's native SDKs, and powering the native layer with the .NET ecosystem.

web.title: Universal Apps
web.description: Build web-based applications that run just as well on iOS, Android, and as Progressive Web Apps.

native.title: Native Access
native.description: Access the full native SDKs on every platform, and ship easily to the App Store, Google Play, or Microsoft Store.

dotnet.title: Powered by .NET
dotnet.description: Keep using npm, TypeScript, and the frameworks you know for the UI layer; bring the C# ecosystem and engineering practices to the native side.

webFeature.title: Works with any web build
webFeature.p1: Native JavaScript, HTML and CSS, or React, Angular, Vue — if it builds to web assets, it runs in Napacitor's native host.
webFeature.p2: Keep using Ant Design Mobile, Ionic or Framework7, or pick MUI, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Vuetify, Quasar and other component ecosystems you know.
webFeature.wallLabel: Supports native web technologies, popular frameworks and component libraries
webFeature.wallFooter: And whatever web tools you reach for next.

plugins.title: Plugin System
plugins.description: Every official plugin wraps .NET MAUI native APIs into a consistent, Promise-based JavaScript interface. You can also build custom plugins as needed.

camera.description: Capture photos and video and pick media, calling system capabilities through a consistent Promise API.

geolocation.description: Get the current location and continuously track the device's position.

filesystem.description: Access app directories, bundled files and the system file picker.

preferences.description: Save app settings and user preferences with lightweight key-value storage.

share.description: Invoke the system share sheet to hand content off to other apps.

clipboard.description: Read and write the system clipboard to pass text between apps.

install.title: Install Napacitor
install.description: From environment setup to first run — build your first Napacitor app.

cli.title: CLI Reference
cli.description: Complete commands and options for init, sync, build, run and assets.

apis.title: Plugin APIs
apis.description: Browse the TypeScript interfaces and platform behavior of official plugins.

enterprise.title: One business frontend for desk and field
enterprise.description: Reuse existing web forms and business UI so desktop clients and mobile devices share one set of product logic.

industrial.title: Bring device capabilities to touch terminals
industrial.description: Connect familiar web UI to the real floor through device, file and sensor plugins.

retail.title: From checkout desktop to staff tablet
retail.description: Unify store UI and interaction for a consistent experience across screens.

education.title: Bring courseware to more classrooms
education.description: Take existing coursework and interactive pages to classroom tablets, student phones and home computers.

productivity.title: Web iteration speed, desktop capability
productivity.description: Evolve the UI fast with JavaScript; connect files, windows and system services with .NET.

engineering.title: Bake cross-platform delivery into automation
engineering.description: Bring the CLI into scripts and CI to repeatedly sync, build, clean and run.

cta.line2: add native capabilities to your web app

footer.vcontrol: V-Control — an out-of-the-box .NET MAUI component library
